info.description: Foundation, catalog, reservations and availability APIs. Web and API share application actions. Permissions require both role and token ability. Dates accept ISO 8601 with explicit offset and seconds; stored UTC, agency dates use Africa/Algiers.

password.description: Required on creation, optional on update. Resets force a password change and revoke sessions/tokens.

daily_rate.description: Nonnegative DZD amount with at most two decimal digits. daily_rate is required.

weekly_rate.description: Nonnegative DZD amount with at most two decimal digits. daily_rate is required.

monthly_rate.description: Nonnegative DZD amount with at most two decimal digits. daily_rate is required.

version.description: Required on update; stale version returns 409.

type.description: Vehicle: insurance, inspection, registration, maintenance. Customer: identity, licence.

ReservationInput.description: Confirmed requires a vehicle. Updates require version and reason. Confirmed cannot become tentative; use cancellation. Current preparation setting is snapshotted on first confirmation, retained on edits. Missing mandatory scans/expiry dates or latest document expiry before return require a Manager override. Override is scoped to vehicle, exact period and document issues; changed period/vehicle/issues requires renewed authorization.

BlockInput.description: Null end means indefinite. Maintenance, administrative and emergency blocks require fleet.manage in addition to blocks.manage. Ordinary overlaps reject; emergency retains bookings and exposes conflicts.
